comments.text: Hungary becomes much more interesting once you look beyond Budapest and cheap-price comparisons. 🇭🇺🏛 Thermal culture, Lake Balaton, rural towns, historic traditions and the country’s demographic challenges all tell different parts of the story. “Affordable” also changes meaning completely depending on whether prices are compared with foreign salaries or local incomes.
